data.title: Can a 17-Year Track Record Protect Bitcoin? Ryan Watkins Weighs In
data.description: Ryan Watkins, Co-Founder of Syncracy Capital, says he’s unsure what happens to Bitcoin if Pearl’s compute footprint passes it, but argues a sudden flip would hurt trust in crypto while a slow one wouldn’t zero out Bitcoin. From Unchained, the no-hype resource for all things crypto.
